name: workspace-app
description: Configure the Workspace App layout, main action, forms and internal links to Agent Chat, Workflow or Automation.
preload_summary: To design or redesign the App page, command the App designer with operation `design_app` and a brief; it shows the person a review card that previews the page, and to revise you call it again with feedback and the draft_id.Design it for the people who use it: when the request names neither a person nor a change (the App's edit button), first call operation `app_audience`, ask with `request_input` who the page is mainly for (up to three people or roles, each with what they act on first, recommending the one with the most waiting on them), then pass the answer to `design_app` as `audience`; an explicit change goes straight to `design_app`.For a small named change, start with operation `get_current`, then use `app_view.update` in a reviewed draft for App entries, targets, forms, layout, or the primary action. Use returned action keys and catalog IDs; an App entry does not require a Workspace Service. Attach a saved Workflow with `workflow_binding.attach` in that same draft. Preserve unrelated App settings and verify the persisted result after approval. For data components, project records, publication metrics, display metadata, or media bindings, call `invoke_skill(skill_id="workspace-app", input=<current request>)` to load the complete guide before drafting.
